name: Oshikake Oku-sama to, Kimi no Uso
original_name: おしかけ奥様と、キミの嘘
source:
Haruse Chiaki, the owner of the struggling secondhand bookstore Kotatsudou, was on the verge of closing it in despair.

In front of him appeared Shinohara Ren, a mysterious beautiful girl.
In exchange for helping the used bookstore recover, Ren demands that Chiaki marry her.

Pushed by Ren, who says she needs to understand the bonds of family, Chiaki accepts the arranged marriage, though he is initially confused.

And so began a slightly strange newlywed life with Ren, who was aiming to be a “perfect family.”

Though confused by Ren’s unconventional behavior, Chiaki gradually begins to feel drawn to her.

[MTLed from the [url=https://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/oshikake_okusama/]official website[/url]]
translation:
经营状况惨淡的旧书店“炬燵堂”店主春濑千明，正陷入绝望，濒临关门歇业的边缘。

就在这时，神秘美少女四之原莲突然出现在了他的面前。
作为协助旧书店起死回生的交换条件，莲竟要求千明与自己结婚。

在声称“必须弄懂何谓家人羁绊”的莲的强势推动下，一头雾水的千明还是稀里糊涂地答应了这桩闪婚。

就这样，千明与一心想要组建“完美家庭”的莲，开启了一段略显奇妙的新婚同居生活。

尽管常常被莲不按常理出牌的古怪举止弄得不知所措，千明却在不知不觉间渐渐被她深深吸引。

[译自[url=https://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/oshikake_okusama/]官方网站[/url]]
